issue_title: [Feature] Add due_date field to Todo for deadline tracking

changes.summary: Added due_date field to Todo dataclass with set_due_date() method and is_overdue property

implementation_details.due_date_field: Optional str | None, defaults to None, stores ISO format datetime
implementation_details.is_overdue_property: Returns True if due_date is set, is in the past, and todo is not done
implementation_details.from_dict_update: Parses due_date from dict, handles None and missing key
